description: Agent Grants: submit a proposed grant budget with the terms in the call or award that govern it: the budget with the grant, the currency, each line with its id, category, what it pays for and amount, the indirect-cost rate and amount, the total it states and the matching funds it commits; the terms with their reference, the grant, the currency, the total cap, each category with its cap, the matching requirement as a percent of the budget total or as an amount, and the highest indirect-cost rate allowed. The signed report gives the budget and the terms, each category total against its cap, the matching funds against the requirement, the indirect-cost rate against the cap and the total against the total cap, with the direct, indirect and computed totals, and counts them, and names a divergent budget: another currency, a total or category above its cap, matching funds below the requirement and an indirect-cost rate above the one allowed; then a stated total or indirect amount unlike the arithmetic, a line in a category the terms do not name and another grant name, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. No lines and no total, lines with no amount or category, a matching requirement with no match committed, or terms that state no cap, matching or indirect rule leaves the budget unverified. Lines total under the category the terms name for them by their words with plurals folded, amounts compare to the cent in one currency and rates to the hundredth of a percent. The budget check returns a verdict on a grant budget against the call or award that governs it: wever_budget-controls-check and wever_agent-budget-guard read an agent’s own spending controls and budget limits and preview whether a request fits them, while no agent’s spending authority is read or set here; wever_budget-forecast-brief projects outflows from figures supplied to it, checks nothing against terms and returns no verdict; and wever_rely-error-budget-check reads an error budget in reliability records against its SLO, and the word is the only overlap, since no uptime or error record is read here. Verdict grant_budget_divergent, grant_budget_partial, grant_budget_unverified or grant_budget_consistent. POST /api/grant-budget-check. Reads the grant records supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; it reads consistency between documents only: it never applies for a grant, awards one, disburses or moves any money, or judges the merit of an applicant, a project, or a funder’s decision, only whether the records agree with each other and with the terms they were written under, and the records stay in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment or external write. Agent Grants reads a grant’s records for consistency between documents: a grant application, a proposed budget, an award letter or grant agreement, milestone records, disbursement records, spending records, a progress or final report and a closeout record, each against the call or guidelines, the terms in the call or award, the application as submitted, the schedules in the award, the approved budget, the records it summarizes or the award terms it should agree with. Beside it, the conditional payments rail tools such as wever_conditional-create create, fund, cancel and report on payments held against conditions between parties, keeping state and moving money, and the Job Records tools such as wever_job-cost-brief read the records of paid work orders, while this family keeps no state, moves nothing, commissions no work and reads the grant records in the call against each other and against the terms they were written under. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-grants-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-grants/.
